blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Despite the turbulent skies facing it and other airlines, Philippine Airlines (PAL) is staying the course with its long-haul expansion, as it finalized on Thursday a deal for up to 14 additional Airbus A350-1000 aircraft. The Lucio Tan-led flag carrier signed definitive agreements with European aircraft manufacturer Airbus and engine maker Rolls-Royce for nine A350-1000 jets, with purchase rights for five more. The signing formalized commitments first announced at the Farnborough International Airshow in July, which brought PAL’s total firm A350-1000 orders to 18 aircraft.
